messages:
Jana: Quick checkound region_penalty overpowering latency/cost for many tenants; example tenant-42 biased to eu-west despite us-east p50 being ~30ms better.
Eric: numbers?
Jana: raw cost=0.6, latency=0.3, region_penalty=0.4 -> final pushes eu-west. Penalty applied additively after normalizing cost/latency to [0,1]. Global penalty_scale seems too large relative to signal spread.
Maya: saw customer tickets matching this pattern.
Tomo: is penalty normalized per-tenant? I thought we did capacity normalization only for affinity.
Jana: not per-tenant. Idea: normalize penalty by distribution instead of absolute value. Options: global_range, tier_percentile, tenant_zscore.
Eric: tenant_zscore noisy for small tenants.
Jana: ran small sim (100k synthetic reqs): baseline 68% eu-west; global_range 42%; tier_percentile 31%; tenant_zscore 29% but +12% churn.
Maya: tier_percentile seems best tradeoff.
Tomo: operational cost: need approximate percentiles in real-time. We have telemetry buckets.
Jana: proposal: maintain t-digest per (region,tier) with 5m sliding window; fallback to global_range if samples < N. Recompute every minute and cache.
Leah: expose config knobs: penalty_scale, penalty_normalization (none|global_range|tier_percentile|tenant_zscore), percentile_window, min_samples_for_percentile, churn_alert_threshold.
Jana: keep custom per-tenant explicit overrides untouched (mark as explicit).
Maya: UX: Console should show estimated routing split and toggle normalization per-tenant.
Eric: rollout plan: 1) config-only sim 24h; 2) canary 5% traffic + alerts (churn >5% or p95 increase >10%); 3) 50% then full.
Leah: track fallback count when samples < N. Add dashboard.
Tomo: implement sim harness to test on historical traces.
Jana: also separate steady vs transient penalties (cold GPU bias as decaying transient penalty). transient has configurable half-life.
Action items:
- Jana: t-digest ingestion & percentile API (eta 3d)
- Tomo: sim harness & historical tests (eta 4d)
- Leah: console toggle + dashboards (eta 5d)
- Eric: alert rules & canary playbook (eta 2d)
- Maya: enterprise comms draft (eta 6d)
infra-bot: Jana opened PR policy/normalization/t-digest-ingest (PR #4217).
Eric: schedule 30m follow-up after sim results.
Jana: will post PR link + sim artifacts in this thread.
Leah: added Asana tasks and dashboard stub. :white_check_mark:
